tasks.title: Forward secrecy on sync
tasks.spec: X25519 + ephemeral keys per session. Past compromise cannot decrypt future.

tasks.title: Side-channel timing audit
tasks.spec: Use SubtleCrypto.measure-timing where possible. Constant-time compare.

tasks.title: Hardware-bound key storage
tasks.spec: On Tauri: use secure enclave/keystore. On web: WebAuthn credential-bound keys.

tasks.title: mTLS for sync endpoints
tasks.spec: If sync server exists, require mutual TLS. Pin server cert by SPKI.

tasks.title: HMAC integrity tags
tasks.spec: Sign persisted snapshots with HMAC-SHA256. Verify on load.

tasks.title: Pinned public keys
tasks.spec: Ship TUF-style key list. Update on user approval.

tasks.title: RNG quality audit
tasks.spec: Only crypto.getRandomValues. No Math.random for security.

tasks.title: Password hashing
tasks.spec: Argon2id for any password. Parameters: m=64MB, t=3, p=1.

tasks.title: Tauri command capability list
tasks.spec: Replace string-based allowlist with typed Capability struct.

tasks.title: CSV import: DDE/DLL injection
tasks.spec: Block =WEBSERVICE, =DDE, =RTD formulas on import.

tasks.title: Backup integrity hash chain
tasks.spec: Hash chain every backup. Detect corruption on read.

tasks.title: Log sanitization: secrets
tasks.spec: Wrap logger.ts to redact: passwords, tokens, PII before write.

tasks.title: Audit log retention policy
tasks.spec: Auto-prune logs > 7 years. Configurable per compliance regime.
